2. **Route through the authorized channel.** If you are in the internal programming or legal review team, you may be entitled to work with this material — but that access should be confirmed through your organization's document-handling process, not through an automated summarization tool.
3. **Ask the document owner.** The restrictions note that distribution requires clearance; the document owner or rights-holder can grant that explicitly.

Please come back once clearance is confirmed and I'll be glad to carry out the full analysis.
